prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one 4:3 landscape painting for The Burnt Book Sanskrit learning story. Request 1536 x 1152 native output or the closest supported native 4:3 resolution. Refined Indian watercolor with restrained gouache on warm ivory paper; organic detail, quiet ochre, sage, dusty terracotta, muted indigo. Warm, gentle, evocative storytelling, consistent character design.
Canonical scene brief: A sunlit palace garden beside a lotus pool; a small laughing child in saffron playing with six boys of different sizes in plain bright clothes, a ball and a toy cart on the grass; a king and a queen watching from a pillared verandah, smiling; a glowing palm leaf resting on the verandah rail.
Character appearances:
naravahanadatta: A baby with large bright eyes and a smiling mouth, wrapped in a saffron cloth with a thin gold edge; later a small laughing child.
vatsaraja: A handsome young king in a pale gold robe with a simple crown and a lute slung at his shoulder, warm eyes and a ready smile.
vasavadatta: A calm young queen in a deep-red sari with a gold border, dark hair in a long plait with jasmine, a thoughtful anxious face that softens into joy.
Phone-first composition: clear compact narrative grouping, essential faces, hands and objects comfortably inside all edges. Show the complete scene without border. No collage or multi-panel layout.
Writing is permitted by the owner. This particular scene needs no readable inscription; focus on its narrative. Do not invent scripts or fill small objects with pseudo-lettering. No watermark or UI.

sources.title: Kathāsaritsāgara, taraṅga 4.3 (Digital Corpus of Sanskrit file KSS, 4, 3), the story retold in new, simple sentences with six real lines quoted
sources.note: The plot follows Somadeva's text: the pregnant queen Vāsavadattā is told in a dream by Śiva to have no fear for her child; the boy is born; a voice from the sky says he is an incarnation of Kāmadeva and names him Naravāhanadatta; flowers fall from the sky, drums sound, there is a great festival, and six ministers' sons are given to him as companions. The quoted lines are Somadeva's own words; the rest is new Sanskrit in the present tense. The closing line, 'the leaf shines', echoes the course's own prologue.

image.brief: A young queen in a deep-red sari asleep on a low bed in a lamp-lit palace chamber, one hand on her belly; at the foot of the bed, a tall figure of matted hair, ash-smeared body and a crescent moon, smiling kindly with a trident held loosely, as if in a dream; moonlight through lattice windows.

alt.en: A queen sleeps with a hand on her belly while a kindly figure with a crescent moon appears in her dream
alt.hi: पेट पर हाथ रखे सोती रानी, स्वप्न में अर्धचन्द्रधारी दयालु आकृति

meaning.en: Vāsavadattā is the queen of the king of Vatsa.
meaning.hi: वासवदत्ता वत्सराज की रानी है।

meaning.en: She carries a child.
meaning.hi: वह गर्भ धारण करती है।

meaning.en: The queen worries.
meaning.hi: रानी चिन्ता करती है।

meaning.en: At night she sees Śiva in a dream.
meaning.hi: रात में वह स्वप्न में शिव को देखती है।

passage.sa: पुत्रि गर्भकृते चिन्ता न कार्या काचन त्वया अहं तवैनं रक्षामि दत्तो ह्येष मयैव ते

meaning.en: “Daughter, you must not worry at all about the child. I protect him: he was given to you by me.” (Śiva, in Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 4.3)
meaning.hi: “पुत्री, गर्भ के विषय में तुम्हें कोई चिन्ता नहीं करनी चाहिए। मैं इसकी रक्षा करता हूँ: यह मेरे ही द्वारा तुम्हें दिया गया है।” (शिव, सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 4.3)

image.brief: A palace lying-in chamber with latticed windows and lamps; a young queen in deep red lying back with a tired smile, a tiny baby in saffron cloth in her arms; a handsome king in pale gold bending over them, wonder and joy on his face; a soft glow around the baby.

alt.en: A king bends over a queen and her newborn son with wonder and joy
alt.hi: रानी और नवजात पुत्र पर आश्चर्य और आनन्द से झुका राजा

meaning.en: The queen bears a son.
meaning.hi: रानी पुत्र को जन्म देती है।

passage.sa: तत्रासूत च सा काले कुमारं कान्तदर्शनम् द्यौर् इन्दुम् इव निर्गच्छद् अच्छामृतमयद्युतिम्

meaning.en: There, in due time, she bore a son lovely to see, like the sky giving forth the moon, whose light was pure nectar. (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 4.3)
meaning.hi: वहाँ, समय आने पर, उसने सुन्दर दर्शन वाले पुत्र को जन्म दिया, मानो आकाश चन्द्रमा को निकाल रहा हो, जिसकी कान्ति निर्मल अमृत-सी थी। (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 4.3)

meaning.en: The king sees his son.
meaning.hi: राजा पुत्र को देखता है।

passage.sa: एत्य चान्तःपुरं सद्यो बद्धौत्सुक्येन चेतसा चिरात् फलितसंकल्पः स ददर्श सुतं नृपः

meaning.en: Coming at once to the women's quarters with an eager mind, the king, his long-held wish fulfilled, saw his son. (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 4.3)
meaning.hi: उत्सुक चित्त से तुरन्त अन्तःपुर आकर, चिरकाल से रखा संकल्प फलित होने पर, राजा ने अपने पुत्र को देखा। (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 4.3)

meaning.en: The king reaches joy.
meaning.hi: राजा हर्ष प्राप्त करता है।

image.brief: A palace courtyard at dusk; the king holding up his baby son in saffron cloth toward the open sky, the queen beside him; pale flower petals falling from above like rain; drummers on the rooftops; lamps lit along the walls; a faint luminous cloud above the courtyard where a voice seems to come from.

alt.en: A king lifts his baby son to the sky as flower petals fall and drums sound
alt.hi: आकाश की ओर पुत्र को उठाता राजा, गिरती फूलों की पंखुड़ियाँ और बजते नगाड़े

meaning.en: A voice comes from the sky.
meaning.hi: आकाश से वाणी आती है।

passage.sa: कामदेवावतारो ऽयं राजञ् जातस् तवात्मजः नरवाहनदत्तं च जानीह्य् एनम् इहाख्यया

meaning.en: “This son born to you, O king, is an incarnation of Kāmadeva. And know him here by the name Naravāhanadatta.” (the voice, Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 4.3)
meaning.hi: “हे राजन्, तुम्हारा यह उत्पन्न पुत्र कामदेव का अवतार है। और उसे यहाँ नरवाहनदत्त नाम से जानो।” (वाणी, सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 4.3)

meaning.en: The son receives the name Naravāhanadatta.
meaning.hi: पुत्र नरवाहनदत्त यह नाम पाता है।

meaning.en: From the sky a fall of flower-showers came down, and the sound of drums spread. (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 4.3)
meaning.hi: आकाश से पुष्पवृष्टि गिरी और दुन्दुभियों की ध्वनि फैल गई। (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 4.3)

meaning.en: There is a festival in the city.
meaning.hi: नगर में उत्सव होता है।

image.brief: A sunlit palace garden beside a lotus pool; a small laughing child in saffron playing with six boys of different sizes in plain bright clothes, a ball and a toy cart on the grass; a king and a queen watching from a pillared verandah, smiling; a glowing palm leaf resting on the verandah rail.

alt.en: A small laughing prince plays with six boys by a lotus pool while the king and queen watch
alt.hi: कमल-सरोवर के पास छह बालकों के साथ खेलता हँसता छोटा राजकुमार

meaning.en: Six ministers' sons serve the prince.
meaning.hi: छह मन्त्रि-पुत्र कुमार की सेवा करते हैं।

meaning.en: The prince plays with them.
meaning.hi: कुमार उनके साथ खेलता है।

meaning.en: The days pass.
meaning.hi: दिन बीतते हैं।

passage.sa: पुत्रं स्मेराननसरसिजं सादरं पश्यतस् ते बद्धानन्दाः किमपि दिवसा वत्सराजस्य जग्मुः

meaning.en: Those days of the king of Vatsa passed, bound in joy, as he gazed lovingly at his son, whose smiling face was a lotus. (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 4.3)
meaning.hi: वत्सराज के वे दिन आनन्द से बँधे बीते, जब वह अपने पुत्र को, जिसका मुस्कराता मुख कमल था, प्रेम से देखता था। (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 4.3)

gloss.en: whose smiling face was a lotus

meaning.en: The leaf shines.
meaning.hi: पत्र चमकता है।
